events.name: Bash
events.head: Poll workspace accounts for team mailbox
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rhoE "[a-z./:]*/accounts\?(search|limit)=[^\"' ]*" cloud/src app/scripts | sort -u | head -5; set -a; source ~/.config/tantra/keys/tantra-api.env; set +a; K=$(env | grep -iE '^TANTRA[A-Z_]*KEY=' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2-); curl -s -H "x-api-key: $K" "https://api.usetantra.com/api/v1/accounts?search=growthclub.org&limit=50" | python3 -c "

events.name: Bash
events.head: Search team mailbox and connected accounts
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; set -a; source ~/.config/tantra/keys/tantra-api.env; set +a; K=$(env | grep -iE '^TANTRA[A-Z_]*KEY=' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2-); for q in "search=team%40growthclub.org" "status=CONNECTED"; do curl -s -o /tmp/acc.json -w "%{http_code} " -H "x-api-key: $K" "https://api.usetantra.com/api/v1/accounts?limit=50&$q"; python3 -c "
